Character & Pack Guide • Born June 20, 1982

Luke, Tessa, and Sadie Bridger

Fraternal brother Luke and identical twin sisters Tessa and Sadie left with only what fit in three canvas packs—plus eighteen years of working seamlessly with six hands.

Born June 20, 1982 (Age 18 in Summer 2000)

Luke Bridger

Fraternal Triplet Brother • First-Person ("I") Narrator & Timber Framer

Steady, observant, and fiercely protective of his sisters, Luke learned traditional timber framing and dry-stone masonry spending summers in Grandpa Owen’s workshop. When their parents demanded the three triplets scatter onto separate lives at eighteen, Luke stepped up to hold the barbed wire open into the forest instead.

How to Spot at a Glance: Tousled sandy-brown hair bleached lighter by June sun, hazel-brown eyes, heather-gray crew shirt under a faded olive flannel overshirt, denim jeans, and weathered work boots.

Carried Past the Fence: Grandpa Owen Sawyer’s waxed-canvas tool roll (shingle froe, hickory camp hatchet, curved drawknife, coiled bow-saw blade, chisels, whetstone, cordage, and trout hooks).

Wilderness Specialties

  • Splitting straight western red cedar planks & roof shakes with froe and wooden maul
  • Dry-stacking Kettle Range granite hearth walls & chimney flues
  • Notching peeled Douglas fir stringers and ridgepoles
Harmony Part: Warm baritone-tenor harmony anchor and steady open-tuning rhythm guitar.
Born June 20, 1982 (Age 18 in Summer 2000)

Tessa Bridger

Identical Twin Sister #1 • Trail Mechanic, Forager & Hearth-Keeper

Direct, fearless, and happiest when solving a physical problem with her hands, Tessa turns anxiety into immediate motion. Give her an armful of willow switches, a pile of river stones, or a hillside of ripening huckleberries, and camp feels like a home before sundown.

How to Spot at a Glance: Long chestnut-brown hair pulled half-back with a leather thong to stay clear of saw blades and campfire smoke, gray-hazel eyes, cream cotton henley under a tan canvas work vest, and a braided brown leather wrist cord.

Carried Past the Fence: The weathered blue-and-white dome tent, ferrocerium fire-starter rod, braided nylon cordage, and half of their dry pantry oats and pinto beans.

Wilderness Specialties

  • Weaving passive red-osier willow funnel traps for cutthroat trout
  • Foraging mountain huckleberries, wild strawberries, wild onions, nettles, and golden chanterelles
  • Rigging storm-tight tarp ridgelines and bear-safe counterbalance food hangs
Harmony Part: Clear, earthy alto-mezzo twin harmony and percussive acoustic rhythm.
Born June 20, 1982 (Age 18 in Summer 2000)

Sadie Bridger

Identical Twin Sister #2 • Navigator, Camp Medic & Songwriter

Thoughtful and steel-spined beneath a quiet smile, Sadie sees terrain patterns and seasonal weather shifts three moves ahead. Every evening by the keyhole fire, her thumb-picked 1970s acoustic chords turn three tired eighteen-year-olds into a band.

How to Spot at a Glance: Exact identical twin face and gray-hazel eyes to Tessa with her chestnut-brown hair worn loose over her shoulders, navy-and-white striped crew tee under a soft burgundy cardigan, and a woven burgundy-and-navy thread bracelet.

Carried Past the Fence: Grandpa Owen’s 1974 Clearwater steel-string dreadnought guitar in its duct-taped black case, laminated quadrangle maps, scarred enamel kettle, and waterproof document pouch.

Wilderness Specialties

  • Reading contour elevations, cold-air drainage, and spring seeps on Forest Service topo maps
  • Wilderness first aid, water boiling & spring-trough food preservation
  • Ration math and sun-drying wild berries on warm granite slabs
Harmony Part: Crystalline 1970s-style soprano-mezzo lead vocal, fingerstyle acoustic guitar, and three-part harmony arranger.
